description: Change the shop's scheduling rules (owner or office; the time zone is owner only). arrival_window_minutes is the default window customers are told for new visits (0 means an exact time). buffer_minutes is travel and setup time find-a-time keeps clear around booked visits. reminder_hours is how long before a visit the customer gets an appointment reminder (0 turns reminders off). on_my_way_notices tells the customer by text and by email when a worker says they are on the way. Text is the main one. The email goes whenever the customer has an email address, even if the text does not. arrival_notices (off by default) adds an arrival time to that message when one is known (a stored route estimate, or the time the worker entered; route data has no drive time, so with no worker time there is no arrival line). The arrived text and email follow on_my_way_notices, the same setting as the on the way message. A do-not-email address is not emailed. Only the fields you send change. Visits already booked keep their window and reminder.

arrival_notices.description: When true, an on the way message includes an arrival time when one is known (a stored route estimate, or the time the worker entered). Off by default. The arrived notice follows on_my_way_notices. No drive time is looked up.

time_zone.description: IANA zone name, for example America/Boise.
